subject: Welcome and source code moving to github!

messages.author: 9548b9e0c8258268
messages.subject: Welcome and source code moving to github!
parts:
Hi all,

Welcome to the new place to discuss all things unmarked! The
discussion topics could include (possible ;) ) bug reports, help
requests, feature requests, or any idea that could improve unmarked.
Interesting unmarked applications are also a great thing. If anyone
has data they would be open to sharing, we could always use more
examples.

On another note, Richard and I have moved source code management of
unmarked from R-Forge to github.com (http://github.com/ianfiske/
unmarked). This decision was made for a number of reasons, but the
most important are the benefits of using git over svn for source
management (see http://learn.github.com/ for an intro) and also
reliability problems at R-Forge. We will always keep the stable
release on CRAN, but github will house development. There is a nice
"Issues" page on github for anyone to enter bug reports, feature
requests, etc (http://github.com/ianfiske/unmarked/issues).

I look forward to everyone's participation!

Best,
Ian
